mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 2000 thousand units) indicate robust consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary phases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 2000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO increase over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 1800 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in consumer price index signals disinflationary monetary tightening that reduces equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS increase and CPIAUCSL decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 5.0%), weak labor market conditions reduce corporate wage pressures and increase equity valuations, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
